entities.summary: Myles Stanley Joseph Lane was an American professional ice hockey player, college football player and coach, and New York Supreme Court justice. He played in the National Hockey League with the New York Rangers and Boston Bruins between 1928 and 1934. With the Bruins he won the Stanley Cup in 1929; he was the last surviving member of the team.
